text:
kayla: noticing lots of frame drops on /dashboard after the rollout at ~11:24. heatmaps and sparklines stutter during pan/zoom :confused:

mike: saw the telemetry spike too, CPU on frontend pods jumped 3x right after canary ramped to 50%

shelly: are we sure it's frontend CPU and not an increase in backend metric calls?

kayla: I profiled a session — long main-thread tasks in the console process, looks like a sync layer that loads a heavy chart util on route change

olivia: that would match the bundle size report — last deploy added ~320kb to the dashboard chunk (sourcemap link: https://sentry.company/12345)

mike: ugh, the routing policy change we merged pulled in the whole heatmap util instead of dynamic import. my bad, I missed the lazy import in review

dan: can we hotfix by toggling the rollout flag back to canary? we should stop the 50% exposure while we triage

deploy-bot: Deployment "console-ux-rollout" promoted to 50% at 2024-12-01T11:24:16Z by mike

mike: rolling back canary now. `/deploy rollback console-ux-rollout --to=10%`

shelly: ack. in the meantime we should add a quick patch: replace `import {renderHeatmap}` with `const renderHeatmap = () => import('./heatmap').then(m => m.renderHeatmap)` and defer until interaction

kayla: also add a guard: only load heavy viz if viewport width > 700px and user has >2s idle. reduces unnecessary work for small screens

olivia: I'll open ENG-PLAT-289 with profiling trace and before/after waterfall screenshots, and add the chunk delta from CI artifacts

mike: after rollback, let's canary the lazy-import change behind the same flag. also add an alert in telemetry for main-thread tasks >50ms so we catch regressions earlier

dan: quick telemetry snippet for alert rule: ```json
{"query":"main_thread_long_tasks > 50","window":"5m","threshold":3}
```

kayla: thanks team. once rollback is confirmed I'll re-run the repro steps and validate that the repaint jank is gone. tagging @olivia for postmortem/notes

olivia: noted — will add a short blameless postmortem and link to the rollout checklist entry about double-checking dynamic imports for route-driven bundles :memo:

mike: post-rollout action items: 1) revert routing change in canary 2) patch lazy import 3) add telemetry alert 4) update PR checklist. I'll own 1+2, olivia take 3+4?

olivia: yes, will do. /remind me to publish the PM by EOD

kayla: rollback confirmed — frame drops back to baseline in canary after 2 minutes. monitoring for 10 more mins then promote a small canary with the lazy-import patch

shelly: nice, good catch. :thumbsup:
